description: Combine two video files into a split-screen video. Stacks clips vertically (1080x1920 for Reels and TikTok) or places them side-by-side. Supports audio mixing and subtitle embedding.

audioSource.description: Audio track selection: 'mix' (blends audio from both videos), 'first' (uses only top/left audio), 'second' (uses only bottom/right audio), or 'mute'. Default: 'mix'.

firstVideoPath.description: Path to the top video (vertical layout) or left video (horizontal layout).

hardwareAcceleration.description: Use hardware-accelerated video encoding (VideoToolbox, NVENC, QSV, etc.) when available. Default: true.

layout.description: Split layout: 'vertical_9_16' (1080x1920 stacked top/bottom for Reels and TikTok), 'horizontal_16_9' (1920x1080 side-by-side), or 'square_1_1' (1080x1080 stacked). Default: 'vertical_9_16'.

outputPath.description: Destination path for the split-screen output file (e.g. './reel.mp4').

secondVideoPath.description: Path to the bottom video (vertical layout) or right video (horizontal layout).

subtitlesPath.description: Optional path to an .srt or .vtt subtitle file to embed into the output video.

name: create_split_screen
